== Course of events ==

After the Gump crashed into a mountain cliff and broke its wings, leaving the travelers stranded, The Scarecrow put forward a plan: rather than continue wandering without direction, the group should seek the counsel of Glinda the Good, who was known to dwell in the South Country. The proposal offered the lost party a clear destination and a reason to press on despite the damage to the Gump.

With The Scarecrow's suggestion agreed upon, everyone climbed aboard the Gump once more, preparing to resume their journey toward the South Country in search of Glinda the Good. The decision to board the Gump again, despite its earlier crash, marked the moment the group committed to Glinda the Good as their goal rather than continuing to wander aimlessly.

This choice set the course for what followed: the Gump rose into the air and flew onward, carrying its passengers south in pursuit of the guidance The Scarecrow had proposed they seek.
